# Justin He

> Personal site of Justin He — engineer, founder of dori, previously Valon and DoorDash. The site holds a short project index, occasional writing, and hobbies.

The homepage is a plain single-page index. Project, blog, and hobby entries live at `/projects/<id>`, `/blog/<id>`, and `/hobbies/<id>`.

## Main

- [Home](https://justinhe.com/): Name, project index, and links to LinkedIn, GitHub, and resume.
- [Projects](https://justinhe.com/projects): Things built, with short captions and dates.
- [Blog](https://justinhe.com/blog): Occasional writing.
- [Hobbies](https://justinhe.com/hobbies): Surfing, climbing, and photos from elsewhere.

## Optional

- [Resume (PDF)](https://justinhe.com/justin_he_resume_2026.pdf): Current resume.
- [Sitemap](https://justinhe.com/sitemap.xml): Full list of indexed URLs.
